finding: AUTHORING LESSON EXTENDED (rule 11 corollary): embedding the knot unannounced with no defusing guarantee is NOT sufficient to wall the floor when the spec states the deciding rule completely and crisply — a careful spec-reader implements it directly, exactly as it implements the visible band. The naive-fails/reference-passes daylight proves the knot exists for a DRIFTING implementer, but haiku-as-spec-reader does not drift. The two knots that HAVE bitten the floor (task02 backslash-in-class 3/5; almanac lichun 1/3) share a property these three lack: the deciding edge either FEELS contradictory to the rule text (malformed-vs-literal) or requires DERIVING a quantity (solar-longitude bisection) rather than applying a stated rule. Next authoring iteration should target felt-contradiction and derived-quantity knots, not crisply-stated boundary rules.
